about_company.about_long: Aimtron Electronics provides electronics system design and manufacturing, including PCB assembly, box-build system integration and ODM programs. It serves industrial, telecom, power, IoT, medical, automotive, defence and other customers. Its India operations are in Vadodara and Bengaluru. The group also includes Aimtron Electronics LLC in Texas and Aimtron International Controls in Decatur, Illinois, following the 2026 acquisition of International Control Services. Revenue comes from design and manufacturing programs; the FY26 product mix reported by the company covers India standalone operations.
about_company.about_short: Aimtron Electronics is an ODM-led ESDM company offering design, PCB assembly, Box Build and system integration.
about_company.business_intro: Aimtron designs and manufactures electronics for industrial and other equipment makers. Customers pay for PCB assembly, full-system box builds and design-led manufacturing programs; its US acquisition joined group results for two months of FY26.

company_timeline.title: Operations began with the first SMT line
Listed on the NSE Emerge platform
Acquired International Control Services in Decatur, Illinois

business_facts.title: India product mix
business_facts.text: In FY26 India standalone revenue, Box Build contributed 68.8%, PCBA 28.6% and ODM 2.6%. These shares exclude the US acquired business.

business_facts.title: India standalone customer geography
business_facts.text: India accounted for 74.3% of FY26 India standalone revenue by customer geography; the USA accounted for 11.1%. This split is not the consolidated group mix.

business_facts.title: India and US operating footprint
business_facts.text: The deck lists manufacturing operations in Vadodara and Bengaluru, and the acquired International Control Services facility in Decatur, Illinois, under the Texas subsidiary.

business_facts.title: Current approvals and qualifications
business_facts.text: The deck lists AS9100D, ISO 13485, IATF 16949, CDSCO and Trusted Telecom Partner status. RDSO railway vendor approval remains in progress.

business_facts.title: US acquisition contribution
business_facts.text: International Control Services, now Aimtron International Controls, contributed US$1.6 million to consolidated FY26 revenue over two months.

what_changed.headline: A US operating business joined Aimtron’s group
what_changed.text: Aimtron acquired International Control Services in Decatur, Illinois, in 2026 and now operates it as Aimtron International Controls. The acquired business contributed US$1.6 million during two months of FY26 consolidation. The reported India product mix therefore describes the standalone India business, while the FY26 group financials include the acquired US operation.
